purpose: Test whether unknown shared demographic forcing, site loadings and the A x H loading effect are recoverable from the frozen real observation-season schedules before real count magnitudes are opened.

fit.data_used: synthetic latent state values observed only at the frozen real breeding seasons
fit.forcing_constraint: mean annual forcing = 0 within each forcing group
fit.loading_constraint: mean site loading = 1 within each forcing group after each ALS loading step
fit.crossover_regression: forcing-group fixed effect + A + H + A:H

selection_rule: Test the frozen Gate 2C regional scale first. Retain it only if the full recovery gate passes. Otherwise fall back to species-wide if species-wide passes. If species-wide also fails, do not open a shared-forcing loading model for that species.
boundary: No real demographic count magnitude is read, summarized, transformed or modeled.
This gate validates latent-factor schedule recovery only; it does not validate count likelihood, vantage offset or accuracy-class observation error.
No new geographic partition, predictor, radius or interaction may be introduced to rescue a failed scale.
Recovery thresholds and simulation parameters cannot be changed after real outcomes are opened.
